tools.name: diagnose_issue
tools.description: Start here. Diagnose one sanitized MCP, API, webhook, agent or integration failure for free. Returns bounded evidence plus a suggested repair service, then use quote_repair only if a priced repair is wanted. It never creates a quote, checkout, payment or repair job. It may record bounded operational

tools.name: quote_repair
tools.description: Use only after diagnose_issue when the caller wants a priced bounded repair. Creates a new non-binding quote for the selected or automatically matched public service. Repeating the call may create a different quoteId, so it is intentionally non-idempotent. It does not accept the quote, create checko

tools.name: prepare_repair
tools.description: Use ONLY for the normal repair flow after quote_repair has already returned a quoteId and the caller explicitly chooses that existing quote. This tool does not create a quote: with confirm=true it records acceptance of that quote and creates checkout instructions on exactly one rail offered by it. D

tools.name: request_delegated_purchase
tools.description: Use ONLY for an owner/platform-preauthorized autonomous purchase of one of four supported micro-services under an explicit spending cap. tools.description: Use after the buyer completes the payment action for a checkout created by prepare_repair.
